  • Tax Equalization Office oversees valuation of all real property in the county (vendor domain burleigh.northdakotaassessors.com) (from the county site listing; confirm with the office)

Cass County, North Dakota property tax involves the county assessment office and the county treasurer.

Who to contact in Cass County

  • Cass County Finance Office
  • Cass County Tax Equalization Office handles assessment and appeals.

What we confirmed on official pages

  • Assessor values reviewed by city/township boards, county director of equalization, county board, then State Board
  • City Board of Equalization first 15 days of April; County Board first ten days of June; State Board second Tuesday of August; must appear at city and county boards first to go to State Board (from the county site listing; confirm with the office)
  • Due: 5% discount if paid in full by Feb 15 (not on specials/drain); 1st installment March 1; 2nd installment October 15; next business day if weekend/holiday
  • Penalties real estate: 3% after Mar 1, then +3% May 1, Jul 1, Oct 15 (12% total on 1st installment); 2nd installment 6% after Oct 15; prior years 1% per month; $50 fee with foreclosure notice at 3 years delinquent
  • Payment: online e-check and cards (convenience fee), in person at Finance Office, mail (postmark), drop box in front of Courthouse
